name: Tobin's Coal-Pan
description: A little iron pan with a lid and a carrying ring, TOBIN ASHE scratched in the lid: what the Spire sends in the autumn to a brother it will call up at midwinter, to carry a coal down to an island beacon. A letter is folded inside where the coal would go. Tobin has held it out past the wall on every turn since the Snuffing, until it went cold and silver. It holds his being called: everything he wanted the Spire to be. A Remnant, made on purpose.
